title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Template NDA v1)
text:
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (TEMPLATE NDA V1)

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Affiliate" means, in relation to a party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that party, where control means the ownership of more than 50 per cent. of the voting rights or the power to appoint a majority of the board.

1.2 "Applicable Law" means all laws, regulations, notices, guidelines and directions of any governmental or regulatory authority (including the Monetary Authority of Singapore) that apply to a party or to the subject matter of this Agreement, as amended from time to time.

1.3 "Business Day" means a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday or gazetted public holiday) on which commercial banks are open for general business in Singapore.

1.4 "Confidential Information" means all information, in any form, disclosed by or on behalf of the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party in connection with the Purpose, including investment strategies, portfolio holdings, pricing, client identities and terms of business, together with all notes and analyses prepared from such information.

1.5 "Purpose" means the evaluation, negotiation and, if agreed, implementation of a possible business relationship between the parties concerning investment management or fund distribution services.

1.6 "Representatives" means, in relation to a party, its Affiliates and its and their directors, officers, employees, professional advisers and auditors who need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose.

1.7 "Personal Data" has the meaning given to it in the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 of Singapore.

2. Confidentiality Obligations
The Receiving Party shall keep the Confidential Information confidential, shall use at least the same degree of care to protect it as it uses for its own confidential information (and no less than reasonable care), and shall not disclose it to any person except as permitted by Clause 5 (Permitted Disclosure). Each party is both a Disclosing Party and a Receiving Party under this Agreement.

3. Use of Confidential Information
The Receiving Party shall use the Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and shall not use it to trade in any securities, to solicit any client of the Disclosing Party, or for any other commercial advantage.

4. Exceptions
The obligations in Clause 2 (Confidentiality Obligations) do not apply to Confidential Information that (a) is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement, (b) was lawfully in the Receiving Party's possession before disclosure, (c) is received from a third party free of any duty of confidence, or (d) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of the Confidential Information.

5. Permitted Disclosure
The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information (a) to its Representatives, provided it procures their compliance with this Agreement, and (b) to the extent required by Applicable Law or by any court or regulatory authority, provided that, where lawful, it gives the Disclosing Party prompt notice so that it may seek a protective order.

6. Return or Destruction
On written request of the Disclosing Party, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all documents containing Confidential Information, except that it may retain copies required by Applicable Law or held in automatic electronic back-up systems, which remain subject to Clause 2 (Confidentiality Obligations).

7. No Licence or Warranty
All Confidential Information remains the property of the Disclosing Party. No licence of any intellectual property is granted, and Confidential Information is provided as is without any warranty as to its accuracy or completeness.

8. Duration
This Agreement continues for two years from the date of this Agreement. The obligations in Clause 2 (Confidentiality Obligations) survive for a further two years after expiry or termination.

9. Remedies
Each party acknowledges that damages alone may not be an adequate remedy for breach of this Agreement and that the Disclosing Party is entitled to seek injunctive relief or specific performance, without prejudice to any other remedy.

10. Data Protection
Each party shall comply with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 in respect of any Personal Data it collects, uses or discloses in connection with this Agreement. A party shall only process Personal Data received from the other party for the purposes of this Agreement, shall protect it with reasonable security arrangements and shall notify the other party without undue delay of any data breach affecting such Personal Data.

11. Notices
Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand or sent by registered post to the address of the recipient set out in the Schedule. A notice is deemed received on delivery by hand or three Business Days after posting.

12. Assignment
Neither party may assign, transfer or novate any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.

13. Entire Agreement
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties relating to its subject matter and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations and understandings, whether written or oral.

14. Severability
If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or unenforceable, that provision shall be severed and the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

15. Variation
No variation of this Agreement shall be effective unless it is in writing and signed by or on behalf of each of the parties.

16. Counterparts
This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which is an original and all of which together constitute one instrument.

17. Third Party Rights
A person who is not a party to this Agreement has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 2001 to enforce any of its terms.

18. Governing Law
This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it are governed by the laws of Singapore.

19. Arbitration
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration in Singapore administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre in accordance with its arbitration rules for the time being in force. The tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator and the language of the arbitration shall be English.

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Fallback and Optional Clauses (v1)
text:
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT - FALLBACK AND OPTIONAL CLAUSES (V1)

S1. Confidentiality Obligations (Enhanced)
The Receiving Party shall keep the Confidential Information strictly confidential, shall disclose it only to those Representatives who have signed a written confidentiality undertaking on terms no less protective than this Agreement, and shall keep a register of all persons to whom Confidential Information has been disclosed, which it shall provide to the Disclosing Party on request.

S2. Confidentiality Obligations (One-Way)
Only the Investment Manager discloses Confidential Information under this Agreement. The counterparty, as Receiving Party, shall keep the Confidential Information confidential and shall not disclose it except as permitted by Clause 5 (Permitted Disclosure); the Investment Manager gives no reciprocal confidentiality undertaking.

S3. Disclosure to Regulators
Nothing in this Agreement prevents either party from disclosing Confidential Information to the Monetary Authority of Singapore or any other regulatory authority having jurisdiction over it in the course of routine supervision or inspection, and no notice to the Disclosing Party is required for such disclosure.

S4. Duration (Three Years)
This Agreement continues for three years from the date of this Agreement. The obligations in Clause 2 (Confidentiality Obligations) survive for a further three years after expiry or termination.

S5. Duration (Extended)
This Agreement continues for five years from the date of this Agreement, and the obligations in Clause 2 (Confidentiality Obligations) in respect of portfolio holdings and trading strategies continue indefinitely for so long as that information remains confidential.

S6. Non-Solicitation
For twelve months from the date of this Agreement, neither party shall, directly or indirectly, solicit or entice away any employee of the other party with whom it had contact in connection with the Purpose, save that general recruitment advertisements not targeted at such employees are permitted.

S7. Non-Solicitation (Six Months)
For six months from the date of this Agreement, neither party shall solicit any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the Purpose, save through general advertisements or recruitment agencies acting without specific instruction.

S8. Standstill
For twelve months from the date of this Agreement, the counterparty shall not, without the prior written consent of the Investment Manager, acquire or offer to acquire any interest in the Investment Manager or any fund managed by it, other than through ordinary subscriptions for Shares on the terms of the Fund Documents.

S9. Residual Knowledge
Nothing in this Agreement restricts the Receiving Party from using general skills, know-how and experience retained in the unaided memory of its Representatives, provided that this does not permit disclosure of the source of such information or of any portfolio holdings, pricing or client identities.

title: Investment Management Agreement (Template IMA v1)
text:
INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT (TEMPLATE IMA V1)

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Affiliate" means, in relation to a party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that party, where control means the ownership of more than 50 per cent. of the voting rights or the power to appoint a majority of the board.

1.2 "Applicable Law" means all laws, regulations, notices, guidelines and directions of any governmental or regulatory authority (including the Monetary Authority of Singapore) that apply to a party or to the subject matter of this Agreement, as amended from time to time.

1.3 "Business Day" means a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday or gazetted public holiday) on which commercial banks are open for general business in Singapore.

1.4 "Client" means the person named as the client in the Schedule, being an accredited investor or institutional investor within the meaning of the Securities and Futures Act 2001.

1.5 "Investment Manager" means the fund management company named in the Schedule, which holds a capital markets services licence for fund management issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

1.6 "Portfolio" means the cash, securities and other assets of the Client placed under the management of the Investment Manager under this Agreement, together with all income and proceeds.

1.7 "Net Asset Value" means the value of the assets of the Portfolio or the Fund (as the context requires) less its liabilities, calculated by the administrator in accordance with the valuation policy in force.

1.8 "Management Fee" means the fee payable to the Investment Manager for its management services, calculated in accordance with Clause 9 (Management Fee).

1.9 "Performance Fee" means the fee payable to the Investment Manager by reference to the increase in Net Asset Value above the High-Water Mark.

1.10 "High-Water Mark" means the highest Net Asset Value at the end of any previous performance period in respect of which a Performance Fee was paid, adjusted for subscriptions and withdrawals.

1.11 "Key Person" means the individual or individuals named as key persons in the Schedule or in the Fund Documents, being the portfolio managers principally responsible for investment decisions.

1.12 "Custodian" means the bank or trust company appointed by the Client to hold the assets of the Portfolio, which shall be independent of the Investment Manager.

1.13 "Losses" means all losses, liabilities, damages, costs (including reasonable legal fees) and expenses, but excluding indirect or consequential loss and loss of profit.

1.14 "Personal Data" has the meaning given to it in the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 of Singapore.

1.15 "Sanctions" means any economic or financial sanctions or trade embargoes administered by the United Nations, Singapore (including under the Monetary Authority of Singapore Act 1970), the European Union, the United Kingdom or the United States, and Sanctioned Person means any person who is the target of Sanctions.

2. Appointment
The Client appoints the Investment Manager to manage the Portfolio on a discretionary basis in accordance with the investment objective and restrictions in Clause 3 (Investment Objective and Restrictions), and the Investment Manager accepts the appointment.

3. Investment Objective and Restrictions
The Investment Manager shall manage the Portfolio in accordance with the investment objective, strategy and restrictions set out in the Schedule and Applicable Law. Any breach of a restriction caused by market movements shall be remedied within ten Business Days, taking due account of the interests of the Client.

4. Regulatory Status
The Investment Manager represents that it holds a capital markets services licence for fund management under the Securities and Futures Act 2001 and undertakes to notify the Client promptly of any suspension, revocation or material condition imposed on that licence by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

5. Custody
The assets of the Portfolio shall be held by the Custodian. The Investment Manager shall not hold client money or assets and is not responsible for the acts or omissions of the Custodian, but shall give the Custodian proper instructions for the settlement of transactions.

6. Best Execution
The Investment Manager shall take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result for the Client when executing orders, having regard to price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, and shall provide its order execution policy on request.

7. Conflicts of Interest
The Investment Manager shall maintain arrangements to identify and manage conflicts of interest, shall allocate investment opportunities and aggregated orders fairly between the Client and its other clients, and shall disclose to the Client any material conflict it cannot manage.

8. Reports
The Investment Manager shall send the Client a statement of the Portfolio within ten Business Days after the end of each month, showing holdings, transactions and the Net Asset Value, and a performance report within twenty Business Days after the end of each quarter.

9. Management Fee
The Client shall pay the Investment Manager a Management Fee at the rate of 1.5 per cent. per annum of the Net Asset Value of the Portfolio, calculated on each valuation day and payable monthly in arrears within ten Business Days of invoice.

10. Performance Fee
The Client shall pay the Investment Manager a Performance Fee equal to twenty per cent. of the increase in Net Asset Value of the Portfolio above the High-Water Mark over each calendar year, payable within twenty Business Days after the year end.

11. Liability of the Investment Manager
The Investment Manager shall not be liable for any Losses suffered by the Client except to the extent caused by the negligence, wilful default or fraud of the Investment Manager or its breach of Applicable Law. The Investment Manager is not liable for Losses resulting from investment decisions made in good faith in accordance with Clause 3 (Investment Objective and Restrictions).

12. Indemnity
The Client shall indemnify the Investment Manager against all Losses incurred in the proper performance of its duties under this Agreement, except Losses caused by the negligence, wilful default or fraud of the Investment Manager.

13. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep confidential all information received from the other party in connection with this Agreement and shall not disclose it except to its Representatives, its auditors and regulators, or as required by Applicable Law. This obligation survives termination of this Agreement for three years.

14. Data Protection
Each party shall comply with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 in respect of any Personal Data it collects, uses or discloses in connection with this Agreement. A party shall only process Personal Data received from the other party for the purposes of this Agreement, shall protect it with reasonable security arrangements and shall notify the other party without undue delay of any data breach affecting such Personal Data.

15. Anti-Money Laundering and Customer Due Diligence
Each party shall comply with Applicable Law on the prevention of money laundering and the financing of terrorism, including MAS Notice SFA04-N02, and shall promptly provide such customer due diligence information and documents as the other party reasonably requests to meet its own obligations.

16. Sanctions
Each party represents that neither it nor any of its Affiliates is a Sanctioned Person, and undertakes not to use any monies or assets in connection with this Agreement for the benefit of a Sanctioned Person or in breach of Sanctions.

17. Termination on Notice
Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving not less than ninety days' written notice to the other party. Termination shall not affect any rights or obligations that have accrued before the date of termination.

18. Termination for Cause
Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the other party commits a material breach which is not remedied within thirty days of notice, becomes insolvent, or ceases to hold any licence or authorisation required by Applicable Law to perform this Agreement.

19. Force Majeure
Neither party shall be liable for any delay or failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, epidemics, war, market closures or failure of settlement systems, provided that it notifies the other party promptly and uses reasonable efforts to mitigate the effect.

20. Notices
Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand or sent by registered post to the address of the recipient set out in the Schedule. A notice is deemed received on delivery by hand or three Business Days after posting.

21. Assignment
Neither party may assign, transfer or novate any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.

22. Entire Agreement
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties relating to its subject matter and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations and understandings, whether written or oral.

23. Variation
No variation of this Agreement shall be effective unless it is in writing and signed by or on behalf of each of the parties.

24. Third Party Rights
A person who is not a party to this Agreement has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 2001 to enforce any of its terms.

25. Governing Law
This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it are governed by the laws of Singapore.

26. Arbitration
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration in Singapore administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre in accordance with its arbitration rules for the time being in force. The tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator and the language of the arbitration shall be English.

title: Investment Management Agreement - Fallback and Optional Clauses (v1)
text:
INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT - FALLBACK AND OPTIONAL CLAUSES (V1)

S1. Sustainability Exclusions
The Investment Manager shall not invest the Portfolio in issuers that derive more than ten per cent. of revenue from thermal coal mining, controversial weapons or tobacco production, as determined by reference to a recognised data provider, and shall report on compliance with this clause in each report under Clause 8 (Reports).

S2. Borrowing and Leverage
The Investment Manager shall not borrow on behalf of the Client or use derivatives to create gross exposure exceeding one hundred and fifty per cent. of the Net Asset Value of the Portfolio, and shall notify the Client within one Business Day of any breach of this limit.

S3. Soft Dollar Arrangements
The Investment Manager may receive research or advisory services from brokers in return for directing transactions to them only where the services assist in the management of the Portfolio, best execution is maintained and the arrangements are disclosed to the Client in the periodic reports.

S4. Voting Rights
The Investment Manager shall exercise, or instruct the Custodian to exercise, voting rights attached to investments in the Portfolio in accordance with its proxy voting policy, and shall provide the Client with an annual summary of votes cast.

S5. Reports (Quarterly)
The Investment Manager shall send the Client a statement of the Portfolio, including holdings, transactions, Net Asset Value and performance, within twenty Business Days after the end of each calendar quarter.

S6. Management Fee (Tiered)
The Client shall pay the Investment Manager a Management Fee of 1.5 per cent. per annum on the first fifty million Singapore dollars of Net Asset Value, 1.25 per cent. per annum on the next fifty million and 1.0 per cent. per annum on any excess, payable monthly in arrears.

S7. Performance Fee (Hurdle)
A Performance Fee of twenty per cent. is payable only on the return of the Portfolio in excess of a hurdle of eight per cent. per annum, and only to the extent that the Net Asset Value also exceeds the High-Water Mark, calculated annually.

S8. Liability Cap
Subject to Clause 11 (Liability of the Investment Manager), the aggregate liability of the Investment Manager in any calendar year shall not exceed the Management Fee received in respect of that year, except in the case of fraud or wilful default.

S9. Mutual Indemnity
Each party shall indemnify the other against all Losses arising from its own breach of this Agreement, negligence, wilful default or fraud, provided that the indemnified party notifies the claim promptly and does not settle it without consent.

S10. Key Person
If any Key Person ceases to be involved in the management of the Portfolio, the Investment Manager shall notify the Client within five Business Days and the Client may, within thirty days of that notice, terminate this Agreement with immediate effect without paying any termination fee.

title: Distribution Agreement (Template DIST v1)
text:
DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT (TEMPLATE DIST V1)

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Affiliate" means, in relation to a party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that party, where control means the ownership of more than 50 per cent. of the voting rights or the power to appoint a majority of the board.

1.2 "Applicable Law" means all laws, regulations, notices, guidelines and directions of any governmental or regulatory authority (including the Monetary Authority of Singapore) that apply to a party or to the subject matter of this Agreement, as amended from time to time.

1.3 "Business Day" means a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday or gazetted public holiday) on which commercial banks are open for general business in Singapore.

1.4 "Investment Manager" means the fund management company named in the Schedule, which holds a capital markets services licence for fund management issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

1.5 "Distributor" means the person appointed under this Agreement to market and arrange subscriptions for Shares, as named in the Schedule.

1.6 "Fund" means the open-ended investment fund (including any variable capital company sub-fund) managed by the Investment Manager and described in the Fund Documents.

1.7 "Shares" means participating shares or units of any class in the Fund.

1.8 "Territory" means Singapore and any other jurisdiction set out in the Schedule as agreed in writing from time to time.

1.9 "Eligible Investor" means an accredited investor or institutional investor within the meaning of section 4A of the Securities and Futures Act 2001, or an equivalent professional investor in another part of the Territory.

1.10 "Fund Documents" means the constitution, private placement memorandum and subscription documents of the Fund, each as amended from time to time.

1.11 "Management Fee" means the fee payable to the Investment Manager for its management services, calculated in accordance with Clause 7 (Remuneration).

1.12 "Subscription Amount" means the amount in the base currency of the Fund that the Investor applies to invest, as stated in the subscription form.

1.13 "Dealing Day" means the first Business Day of each calendar month and any other day determined by the directors of the Fund.

1.14 "Losses" means all losses, liabilities, damages, costs (including reasonable legal fees) and expenses, but excluding indirect or consequential loss and loss of profit.

1.15 "Personal Data" has the meaning given to it in the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 of Singapore.

1.16 "Sanctions" means any economic or financial sanctions or trade embargoes administered by the United Nations, Singapore (including under the Monetary Authority of Singapore Act 1970), the European Union, the United Kingdom or the United States, and Sanctioned Person means any person who is the target of Sanctions.

2. Appointment of Distributor
The Investment Manager appoints the Distributor on a non-exclusive basis to market the Shares to Eligible Investors in the Territory, and the Distributor accepts the appointment on the terms of this Agreement.

3. Selling Restrictions
The Distributor shall offer the Shares only to Eligible Investors, shall not make any offer to the retail public or any offer requiring a prospectus, and shall comply with the selling restrictions in the Fund Documents for each jurisdiction in the Territory.

4. Marketing Materials
The Distributor shall use only marketing materials approved in writing by the Investment Manager and shall not make any representation about the Fund that is inconsistent with the Fund Documents.

5. Regulatory Compliance
The Distributor represents that it holds, or is exempt from holding, all licences required under the Securities and Futures Act 2001 and the Financial Advisers Act 2001 to perform its obligations, and shall comply with all Applicable Law in the Territory.

6. Investor Due Diligence
The Distributor shall perform customer due diligence on each investor it introduces in accordance with Clause 13 (Anti-Money Laundering and Customer Due Diligence) and shall provide copies of the due diligence records to the Investment Manager or the Fund's administrator within two Business Days of request.

7. Remuneration
In consideration of its services the Distributor shall receive a trailer fee equal to thirty per cent. of the Management Fee received by the Investment Manager in respect of Shares held by investors introduced by the Distributor, payable quarterly in arrears.

8. Complaints
The Distributor shall notify the Investment Manager within two Business Days of any complaint from an investor relating to the Fund and shall co-operate in its investigation and resolution.

9. Audit and Records
The Distributor shall keep complete records of its activities under this Agreement for at least five years and shall permit the Investment Manager or its auditors, on ten Business Days' notice, to inspect those records to verify compliance with Clause 3 (Selling Restrictions).

10. Indemnity
The Distributor shall indemnify the Investment Manager and the Fund against all Losses arising from any breach by the Distributor of Clause 3 (Selling Restrictions) or Clause 4 (Marketing Materials), or any misrepresentation made by it to an investor.

11. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep confidential all information received from the other party in connection with this Agreement and shall not disclose it except to its Representatives, its auditors and regulators, or as required by Applicable Law. This obligation survives termination of this Agreement for three years.

12. Data Protection
Each party shall comply with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 in respect of any Personal Data it collects, uses or discloses in connection with this Agreement. A party shall only process Personal Data received from the other party for the purposes of this Agreement, shall protect it with reasonable security arrangements and shall notify the other party without undue delay of any data breach affecting such Personal Data.

13. Anti-Money Laundering and Customer Due Diligence
Each party shall comply with Applicable Law on the prevention of money laundering and the financing of terrorism, including MAS Notice SFA04-N02, and shall promptly provide such customer due diligence information and documents as the other party reasonably requests to meet its own obligations.

14. Sanctions
Each party represents that neither it nor any of its Affiliates is a Sanctioned Person, and undertakes not to use any monies or assets in connection with this Agreement for the benefit of a Sanctioned Person or in breach of Sanctions.

15. Termination on Notice
Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving not less than ninety days' written notice to the other party. Termination shall not affect any rights or obligations that have accrued before the date of termination.

16. Termination for Cause
Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the other party commits a material breach which is not remedied within thirty days of notice, becomes insolvent, or ceases to hold any licence or authorisation required by Applicable Law to perform this Agreement.

17. Notices
Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand or sent by registered post to the address of the recipient set out in the Schedule. A notice is deemed received on delivery by hand or three Business Days after posting.

18. Assignment
Neither party may assign, transfer or novate any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.

19. Entire Agreement
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties relating to its subject matter and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations and understandings, whether written or oral.

20. Variation
No variation of this Agreement shall be effective unless it is in writing and signed by or on behalf of each of the parties.

21. Governing Law
This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it are governed by the laws of Singapore.

22. Arbitration
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration in Singapore administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre in accordance with its arbitration rules for the time being in force. The tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator and the language of the arbitration shall be English.

title: Distribution Agreement - Fallback and Optional Clauses (v1)
text:
DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT - FALLBACK AND OPTIONAL CLAUSES (V1)

S1. Exclusive Appointment
The Investment Manager appoints the Distributor as its exclusive distributor of the Shares to Eligible Investors in the Territory for an initial period of two years, during which the Investment Manager shall not appoint any other distributor in the Territory, save for its own direct marketing.

S2. Remuneration (Fixed Fee)
The Distributor shall receive a fixed placement fee of one per cent. of the Subscription Amount of each investor it introduces, payable within thirty days of the relevant Dealing Day, and no other remuneration.

S3. Sub-Distributors
The Distributor may appoint sub-distributors in the Territory only with the prior written consent of the Investment Manager, shall ensure each sub-distributor is bound by obligations equivalent to Clause 3 (Selling Restrictions), and remains liable for their acts and omissions.

title: Side Letter - Fallback and Optional Clauses (v1)
text:
SIDE LETTER - FALLBACK AND OPTIONAL CLAUSES (V1)

S1. Most Favoured Nation
If the Investment Manager enters into a side letter with any Similar Investor granting rights more favourable than those granted to the Investor, the Investment Manager shall notify the Investor within thirty days and the Investor may elect, within thirty days of that notice, to receive the same rights on the same terms and conditions.

S2. Most Favoured Nation (Limited)
The Investor may elect to receive any more favourable rights granted to a Similar Investor, except rights relating to fees, capacity or co-investment, rights granted to address the legal or regulatory requirements of a particular investor, and rights granted to investors whose subscription exceeds that of the Investor.

S3. Management Fee Rebate
The Investment Manager shall rebate to the Investor an amount equal to 0.25 per cent. per annum of the Net Asset Value of the Investor's Shares out of the Management Fee it receives, calculated monthly and paid quarterly in arrears, either in cash or by issue of additional Shares.

S4. Excuse Rights
The Investor may be excused from participating in any investment by the Fund in issuers engaged in the production of controversial weapons or thermal coal, and the Investment Manager shall make such arrangements, including through a separate share class, as are reasonably necessary to give effect to this right.

S5. Additional Reporting
The Investment Manager shall provide the Investor, within thirty days after each quarter end, with a look-through report of the Fund's holdings, exposures by sector and country, and the top ten positions, which the Investor shall treat as confidential in accordance with Clause 3 (Confidentiality).

S6. Key Person Notification
The Investment Manager shall notify the Investor within five Business Days if any Key Person ceases to devote substantially all of his or her business time to the Fund, and the Investor may redeem its Shares on the next Dealing Day without any redemption fee or notice period.

S7. Transfers to Affiliates
Notwithstanding the Fund Documents, the Investor may transfer all or part of its Shares to an Affiliate without the consent of the directors of the Fund, subject only to the transferee satisfying the customer due diligence requirements of the Fund.

S8. Co-Investment Opportunities
The Investment Manager shall use reasonable efforts to notify the Investor of any co-investment opportunity offered to other investors alongside the Fund, and the Investor may participate on terms no less favourable than those offered to other co-investors, subject to allocation at the discretion of the Investment Manager.

S9. Capacity Rights
If the Fund is closed to new subscriptions, the Investor shall remain entitled to make additional subscriptions of up to fifty million Singapore dollars in aggregate over the following two years.

S10. Regulatory Information
The Investment Manager shall provide the Investor promptly on request with such information about the Fund as the Investor reasonably requires to meet its own regulatory, tax or reporting obligations, including information requested by its regulator.

title: Subscription Agreement (Template SUBS v1)
text:
SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT (TEMPLATE SUBS V1)

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Affiliate" means, in relation to a party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that party, where control means the ownership of more than 50 per cent. of the voting rights or the power to appoint a majority of the board.

1.2 "Applicable Law" means all laws, regulations, notices, guidelines and directions of any governmental or regulatory authority (including the Monetary Authority of Singapore) that apply to a party or to the subject matter of this Agreement, as amended from time to time.

1.3 "Business Day" means a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday or gazetted public holiday) on which commercial banks are open for general business in Singapore.

1.4 "Investment Manager" means the fund management company named in the Schedule, which holds a capital markets services licence for fund management issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

1.5 "Fund" means the open-ended investment fund (including any variable capital company sub-fund) managed by the Investment Manager and described in the Fund Documents.

1.6 "Shares" means participating shares or units of any class in the Fund.

1.7 "Net Asset Value" means the value of the assets of the Portfolio or the Fund (as the context requires) less its liabilities, calculated by the administrator in accordance with the valuation policy in force.

1.8 "Dealing Day" means the first Business Day of each calendar month and any other day determined by the directors of the Fund.

1.9 "Subscription Amount" means the amount in the base currency of the Fund that the Investor applies to invest, as stated in the subscription form.

1.10 "Eligible Investor" means an accredited investor or institutional investor within the meaning of section 4A of the Securities and Futures Act 2001, or an equivalent professional investor in another part of the Territory.

1.11 "Investor" means the person named as the investor in this letter, including any permitted transferee of its interest in the Fund.

1.12 "Fund Documents" means the constitution, private placement memorandum and subscription documents of the Fund, each as amended from time to time.

1.13 "Losses" means all losses, liabilities, damages, costs (including reasonable legal fees) and expenses, but excluding indirect or consequential loss and loss of profit.

1.14 "Personal Data" has the meaning given to it in the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 of Singapore.

1.15 "Sanctions" means any economic or financial sanctions or trade embargoes administered by the United Nations, Singapore (including under the Monetary Authority of Singapore Act 1970), the European Union, the United Kingdom or the United States, and Sanctioned Person means any person who is the target of Sanctions.

2. Subscription
The Investor irrevocably applies to subscribe for Shares for the Subscription Amount at the Net Asset Value per Share on the relevant Dealing Day, on the terms of the Fund Documents.

3. Payment
The Subscription Amount shall be paid in cleared funds to the account of the Fund at least three Business Days before the relevant Dealing Day. If payment is not received in time, the subscription may be deferred to the next Dealing Day.

4. Investor Representations
The Investor represents that it is an Eligible Investor and, in particular, an accredited investor within the meaning of section 4A of the Securities and Futures Act 2001, that it has not opted out of accredited investor status, and that it is subscribing for its own account.

5. Source of Funds
The Investor represents that the Subscription Amount is not derived from any unlawful activity and undertakes to provide such information on its source of funds and source of wealth as the Fund may require under Clause 11 (Anti-Money Laundering and Customer Due Diligence).

6. Transfer Restrictions
The Investor shall not transfer any Shares without the prior written consent of the directors of the Fund, which may be withheld if the transferee is not an Eligible Investor or would cause the Fund to breach Applicable Law.

7. Redemption
The Investor may redeem Shares on any Dealing Day by giving at least thirty days' written notice to the administrator. Redemption proceeds are normally paid within ten Business Days after the Dealing Day.

8. Tax Information
The Investor shall provide such self-certification forms and information as the Fund requires to comply with the United States Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act and the Common Reporting Standard as implemented in Singapore, and shall update them within thirty days of any change in circumstances.

9. Risk Acknowledgement
The Investor acknowledges that it has read the Fund Documents, that an investment in the Fund involves a high degree of risk including the possible loss of the entire Subscription Amount, and that it has obtained such independent advice as it considers appropriate.

10. Indemnity
The Investor shall indemnify the Fund, the Investment Manager and the administrator against all Losses arising from any representation in Clause 4 (Investor Representations) being untrue or misleading.

11. Anti-Money Laundering and Customer Due Diligence
Each party shall comply with Applicable Law on the prevention of money laundering and the financing of terrorism, including MAS Notice SFA04-N02, and shall promptly provide such customer due diligence information and documents as the other party reasonably requests to meet its own obligations.

12. Data Protection
Each party shall comply with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 in respect of any Personal Data it collects, uses or discloses in connection with this Agreement. A party shall only process Personal Data received from the other party for the purposes of this Agreement, shall protect it with reasonable security arrangements and shall notify the other party without undue delay of any data breach affecting such Personal Data.

13. Sanctions
Each party represents that neither it nor any of its Affiliates is a Sanctioned Person, and undertakes not to use any monies or assets in connection with this Agreement for the benefit of a Sanctioned Person or in breach of Sanctions.

14. Notices
Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand or sent by registered post to the address of the recipient set out in the Schedule. A notice is deemed received on delivery by hand or three Business Days after posting.

15. Entire Agreement
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties relating to its subject matter and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations and understandings, whether written or oral.

16. Governing Law
This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it are governed by the laws of Singapore.

17. Arbitration
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration in Singapore administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre in accordance with its arbitration rules for the time being in force. The tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator and the language of the arbitration shall be English.

title: Subscription Agreement - Fallback and Optional Clauses (v1)
text:
SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT - FALLBACK AND OPTIONAL CLAUSES (V1)

S1. Investor Representations (Institutional)
The Investor represents that it is an institutional investor within the meaning of section 4A of the Securities and Futures Act 2001, such as a bank, insurer, pension fund or government entity, and that it is subscribing as principal.

S2. Redemption (Quarterly)
The Investor may redeem Shares only as at the last Dealing Day of each calendar quarter by giving at least sixty days' written notice, and redemption proceeds are paid within twenty Business Days.

S3. Redemption Gate
The directors of the Fund may limit total redemptions on any Dealing Day to ten per cent. of the Net Asset Value of the Fund, in which case redemption requests shall be reduced pro rata and the balance carried forward to the next Dealing Day with priority.

S4. Redemption in Specie
With the consent of the Investor, the directors of the Fund may satisfy a redemption request in whole or in part by transferring assets of the Fund in specie, valued on the same basis as used to calculate the Net Asset Value.

title: Boilerplate Fallback and Optional Clauses (v1)
text:
BOILERPLATE FALLBACK AND OPTIONAL CLAUSES (V1)

B1. Cross-Border Transfer of Personal Data
A party may transfer Personal Data outside Singapore only where the recipient is bound by legally enforceable obligations to provide a standard of protection comparable to that under the Personal Data Protection Act 2012, and shall on request provide the other party with details of the jurisdictions to which Personal Data is transferred and the safeguards applied.

B2. Anti-Bribery and Corruption
Each party shall comply with the Prevention of Corruption Act 1960 and all other applicable anti-bribery laws, shall not offer or accept any inducement in connection with this Agreement, and shall maintain adequate procedures designed to prevent bribery by persons acting on its behalf.

B3. Termination on Short Notice
Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving not less than thirty days' written notice to the other party, without penalty. Fees shall be apportioned to the date of termination.

B4. Notices by Email
Any notice under this Agreement may be given by email to the address set out in the Schedule and is deemed received when sent, unless the sender receives an automated message that the email has not been delivered. Notices of termination shall also be sent by registered post.

B5. Assignment to Affiliates
Either party may assign its rights under this Agreement to an Affiliate on written notice to the other party, provided that the assignee holds all licences required by Applicable Law and the assignor remains liable for the assignee's performance.

B6. Electronic Signatures
The parties agree that this Agreement may be signed by electronic signature in accordance with the Electronic Transactions Act 2010, and that an electronically signed copy shall be as valid and binding as an original signed in wet ink.

B7. Governing Law (England and Wales)
This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it are governed by the laws of England and Wales.

B8. Jurisdiction of the Singapore Courts
The courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, and each party irrevocably submits to the jurisdiction of those courts.

B9. Arbitration (London)
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the rules of the London Court of International Arbitration. The seat of arbitration shall be London and the tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator.

B10. Limitation of Liability
Except in the case of fraud or wilful default, each party's aggregate liability under or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, and neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential loss or loss of profit.

B11. Limitation of Liability (Fixed Cap)
Except in the case of fraud or wilful default, each party's aggregate liability under or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed one million Singapore dollars, and neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential loss or loss of profit.
